attchmntText: We hereby inform that an "Earnings Conference Call" is scheduled on, Monday, November 16, 2026 at 15:00 hours (IST).
voiceSummary: Rane Madras Limited announces an Earnings Conference Call for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. The call is scheduled for Monday, November 16, 2026, from 15:00 hrs to 16:00 hrs IST. Management will discuss the unaudited financial results. Dial-in numbers include +91 22 6280 1107 and +91 22 7115 8008. International toll-free lines are available for the USA, UK, Singapore, and Hong Kong. Pre-registration is available via DiamondPass. Management representatives include Mr. Harish Lakshman, Chairman of Rane Group, Dr. P.A. Padmanabhan, President and Group CFO, Mr. B. Gnanasambandam, Sr. EVP and CFO of Rane Madras Limited, Mr. J. Ananth, EVP and CFO of Rane Holdings Limited, and Mr. S. Prasad, VP of Corporate Planning at Rane Holdings Limited. The presentation and transcript will be available on www.ranegroup.com. This disclosure is submitted under Regulation 30 of SEBI LODR Regulations 2015.

attchmntText: We hereby enclose the copies of extract of Un-audited (Standalone and Consolidated) financial results of the Company for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026 published on November 04, 2026 in the Newspapers, viz; "Business Standard" (English) and "Hindu Tamizh Thisai" (Regional Language).

This is to inform that the Board of Directors at their meeting held today, have inter-alia approved the un-audited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The meeting of the Board commenced at 10:53 hrs (IST) and concluded at 14:58 hrs (IST).
